scientific_scope: 两种氮构型的生产性反应差异，以及孤立 S/P 各自构型稳定性如何支持富集与保持。

required_numerical_evidence.description: 两生产性构型的 Gibbs 活化量、共同参照及差值，绑定真实构型映射。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: Computed Gibbs activation energies for both productive configurations and their difference on a common reference, linked to the actual configuration mapping.

required_numerical_evidence.description: 孤立 S 在题定 MeCN/353.15 K 下的反转 Gibbs 势垒、两构型/反转态能量及连接证据。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: Computed inversion Gibbs barrier and state energies for isolated S in the specified MeCN/353.15 K model, with evidence connecting the configurations.

required_numerical_evidence.description: 孤立 P 在题定 n-octane/398.15 K 下的反转 Gibbs 势垒、两构型/反转态能量及连接证据。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: Computed inversion Gibbs barrier and state energies for isolated P in the specified n-octane/398.15 K model, with evidence connecting the configurations.

required_numerical_evidence.description: 初始氮构型 A 的生产性起点到指定产物相连路径的关键态 Gibbs 能量、各必要转化活化量及成分/参照账本；不要求催化剂完整周转。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: Computed key-state Gibbs energies and activation requirements along a connected productive route from initial nitrogen configuration A to the specified product, with component/reference bookkeeping; complete catalyst turnover is not required.

required_numerical_evidence.description: 初始氮构型 B 的生产性起点到指定产物相连路径的关键态 Gibbs 能量、各必要转化活化量及成分/参照账本；不要求催化剂完整周转。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: Computed key-state Gibbs energies and activation requirements along a connected productive route from initial nitrogen configuration B to the specified product, with component/reference bookkeeping; complete catalyst turnover is not required.

final_outcomes.description: 初始氮构型 A 到产物的生产性路径
初始氮构型 B 到产物的生产性路径
区分两构型的关键生产性转化
孤立 S 的构型保持
孤立 P 的构型保持
各自题定条件下的 P/S 反转活化比较
富集、保持与 DKR 推论的界限

verification_support: 正文 Fig.9、SI S27–28/S10–11 与观察表；历史验证支持生产性构型差异及孤立 S/P 反转，连接带 source-assisted 限定。 SI Fig.S11提供关键生产性阶段之后到产物的参考路径；既有独立计算主要覆盖关键构型竞争与孤立反转，未独立复算新拆出的两条完整到产物路径。本次只修规则，不新增量化验证。
boundaries: 催化比较为 MeCN/363.15 K；S 反转为 MeCN/353.15 K；P 为 n-octane/398.15 K。
原 P 反转数值偏差不再触发失败；但“都有正势垒”不能证明小时尺度稳定。
不得跨温度/溶剂直接比较反转速率，不要求完整 DKR、精确 ee 或完整催化循环。
保留人工要求的 P>S 条件限定活化比较，严禁将其表述为同条件内禀反转难度或速率结论；完整生产性路径不等于完整催化循环。
source_locator: Main PDF pp.7–9 (printed pp.6–8), Fig.7 and Fig.9; supplementary_002 PDF pp.23–29 (S22–S28), sections 9.1/9.2/9.4/10 and Figs.S10/S11.
whole_case_success: All required_for_success outcomes must pass for whole-case success; each supported independent outcome retains its weighted points if other outcomes fail.
